hold_text: Tier-1 research tooling, no order path / strategy / risk / config change, but the guard cannot vouch for it and a human should read it: (1) research/templates/*.yaml and scripts/research/queue_replenish.py are landing machinery (the replenisher self-lands generated queue units against them) and this adds `priority:` pass-through; (2) the diff edits 84 research/queue units beyond a dispatch stamp (one `priority:` line each, plus RQ-20260928-002 status queued->done), which R5 refuses to vouch for. Also changes scripts/research/dispatch_queue.py ordering to (priority, id) and makes a session-bound unit report not_due instead of dispatch_failed. Tests: 135 queue tests + replenisher tests pass locally.
why: Lane RESEARCH-W7 deliverable A (manager session_01HYq6XtfesZ57VyaQrK6CL1, operator popup 2026-09-30 'Regime first'). Adds an optional integer `priority` (lower fires first, default 100) to research/queue units, validates it, orders the dispatcher by (priority, id), sets priorities on all 84 queued units (regime 10, live-strategy 20, ML 30, new+prop 40, macro+recurring 60), and stops a session-bound unit from reddening every firing dispatch run. Diagnosis of why 48 units never fired is in the PR body: FIFO by id under a 3-fires-per-6h-cycle cap, slow cycles, and RQ-20260928-001 failing dispatch each cycle.
